result:
The build succeeded, and the bundled `sample.wav` landed exactly where the runtime code expects it (`<app>/app/assets/sample.wav`, matching `knownFolders.currentApp().path + '/assets/sample.wav'`).

Summary of changes for section 5 (Transcribe/Speech):
- `app/components/Transcribe.vue` — wired to `SFSpeechRecognizer`/`SFSpeechURLRecognitionRequest` for authorization status, request access, and streaming transcription with partial results, elapsed-time display, and error surfacing in the status line.
- `app/assets/sample.wav` — copy of `spec-assets/sample.wav` (spec-assets itself untouched) so Vite bundles it into the app.
- `App_Resources/iOS/Info.plist` — added `NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription`, required for the authorization prompt to not crash.

`ns build ios` passes cleanly.
